title: Wiebe et al. (2024), Translational Psychiatry, adult ADHD virtual-reality classification study
access: Full text available; targeted Methods passages inspected in this follow-up
supported_points: Training ADHD participants were not currently under medication; test ADHD participants discontinued medication for 48 hours.
The task used three 18-minute CPT blocks.
Training EEG powers were averaged across all three blocks.
Only the single no-feedback block from the test-set feedback experiment was used.
limit: The source primary study was read; this follow-up did not inspect its raw adult data or rerun its models.
